about: GARO's look as numbers, for the Parkmed check (--look garo). Taken on 23 Nov 2026 from GARO's own sources in rs303593/parkmed-garo: docs/design/garo-look/garo-themes.css (palette A, Forest & Coral, light and dark; the type scale; the radii) and design.md sections 2.3 and 2.4. When GARO's look changes, take them again.

spacing.notes: Every padding, margin and gap a multiple of 4 (the owner, 8 Nov 2026), on the scale 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64 (design.md section 2.3; GARO's own check is app/tools/look/space_check.py). Strokes of 1 to 3 px are not spaces.

radius.notes: design.md section 2.4: controls (buttons, fields, chips, toggles) are pills; 6 for checkboxes; 10 inner squares; 16 tiles; 24 cards; 32 the hero and the app frame; a surface inside a card takes the card's radius minus its padding (8 inside a 24 card with 16 padding, 0 inside one with 24). Marks 64 px or smaller both ways (a dot, a tick, a grade letter, an icon) keep their own radius and are not checked.

fontSizes.notes: The --gx-fs-* sizes of garo-themes.css (captions 12, labels 14, body 16, titles 18 to 24, display and numbers up to 52), and the sizes garo-ui.css writes outside them: 13 (71 rules), 15 (47), 17 (6) and 11, counted 23 Nov 2026.

colors.notes: Colours only as --gx-* roles (GARO's rule): the roles of palette A, light, with the dark theme's values as alsoUsed. A colour within a shade of a role is fixed to it.
